about_h1_1: Investigation and Intelligence Solutions for Private, Business, and Legal Clients
about_h2_3: Intelligence Expertise. Field Experience. Proven Results.
about_p_21: P.R.D.S Investigations is a registered private investigation firm managed by Yair Bloom – a licensed private investigator on behalf of the Ministry of Justice, specializing in providing advanced investigation and intelligence services to private clients, companies, and legal entities.
about_p_22: We provide precise, discreet, and strategic solutions to every complex challenge – from personal inquiries and family law matters, through information security and business integrity, to admissible evidence for legal proceedings.
about_p_23: The principles that guide every investigation and every professional decision we make
about_p_24: All information that reaches us is kept under full and unwavering confidentiality. We exercise the utmost discretion at every stage — from the first meeting to the delivery of the final report — and ensure that the identity of our clients, the circumstances of the inquiry, and the contents of the investigation never reach unauthorized hands.
about_p_25: Whether it involves locating hidden assets, exposing internal embezzlement, or conducting discreet personal inquiries — our team combines expertise from the intelligence community with advanced field methodologies, to deliver clear and verified evidence for any personal, legal, or corporate challenge.
about_p_26: We believe that an informed client is a secure client. That is why we communicate clearly about timelines, scope of work, interim findings, and the limits of what is possible. We do not promise what we cannot deliver, and we always provide a complete and reliable picture — even when the answer is not what the client expected to hear.
about_p_27: Every investigation is managed as an intelligence mission: preliminary mapping, defining objectives, selecting a precise methodology, and analyzing findings that enable the client to make informed decisions. Our findings are a strategic working tool — not just a report.
about_p_28: Behind every case stands a person — sometimes under pressure, uncertainty, or business harm. We treat every client with respect, attentiveness, and genuine empathy. Our human approach does not conflict with professional sharpness — it is an inseparable part of it, and enables optimal collaboration throughout the entire process.
about_p_29:
P.R.D.S Investigations

 is a licensed investigation firm, operating in Israel and on the international stage.
The company provides professional, independent, and reliable services to a wide range of clients, organizations, and professionals. We specialize in obtaining accurate information, uncovering the truth, and delivering comprehensive investigative solutions to any challenge, no matter how complex.
about_p_30: The firm's professional team consists of experienced private investigators and analysts, graduates of intelligence and security units within the Israeli defense establishment, with extensive operational experience in information analysis, financial investigations, and capital flow tracking. Our approach combines proven intelligence methodologies with advanced technological tools, enabling us to operate effectively both in Israel and across various countries worldwide.
about_p_31: Every case is handled under direct and full supervision, with absolute confidentiality, strict compliance with legal requirements, and an uncompromising commitment to quality. We believe that a true investigation begins with a deep understanding of the client's personal and legal needs — and ends with clear, documented, and actionable findings.
about_p_32: Spouses, family members, neighbors, business partners — when something doesn't add up and you need to know the truth, we are here. With complete discretion and without judgment.
about_p_33: Every inquiry is handled personally and respectfully. We listen, explain what is possible and what is not — and deliver clear answers, not complicated reports.
about_p_34: The firm operates under a license from the Ministry of Justice. Every investigation is conducted within the bounds of the law — so our findings are also valid in legal proceedings when necessary.
about_p_36: Every investigation is conducted according to a structured, transparent, and lawful methodology — from the first meeting to the final findings. This is how we ensure absolute discretion, professionalism, and strategic support at every stage.
about_p_37: A structured and discreet introductory meeting in which we listen to the need, examine the scope of the request, and verify its legal feasibility. All information provided is kept in absolute confidentiality.
about_p_38: Together we define the investigation's objectives, timeline, required resources, and success criteria. At this stage, a written and binding work plan is agreed upon — due diligence for companies in Israel and abroad is included as needed.
about_p_39: Where necessary, the team of analysts, veterans of the defense establishment, carries out the financial investigation, business intelligence, digital surveillance, and evidence gathering — while strictly adhering to the law and the principles of professional ethics.
about_p_40: We deliver a structured, clear, and actionable findings report — suitable for legal, business, or managerial use. Personal guidance by Yair Bloom ensures that the conclusions are translated into informed decisions.

services_h2_1: Our Approach in Practice — Case Studies
services_h2_3:
Business Intelligence —
Knowledge That Drives the Right Decisions
services_p_46: Every case is unique. Below are anonymous examples of how Pardes Investigations handles complex cases — while maintaining absolute client confidentiality.
services_p_47: A comprehensive and in-depth service encompassing the collection, analysis, and processing of business, financial, and strategic intelligence. We provide a complete picture of potential business partners, competitors, markets, and trends — so you can make fact-based decisions with full confidence.
services_p_48: Assessing financial capability, uncovering fraud and embezzlement, and locating hidden assets. We specialize in revealing the true financial reality behind business facades.
services_p_49: Due diligence for companies in Israel and abroad prior to partnerships, investments, mergers, and acquisitions. A professional and detailed report enabling informed and secure decision-making.
services_p_50: Identifying organizational vulnerabilities, evaluating internal and external exposures and risks, and building a comprehensive risk profile to support informed management decisions.
services_p_51: Uncovering theft, embezzlement, information leaks, and industrial espionage within the organization. Professional internal investigations conducted with absolute discretion and in full compliance with the law.
services_p_52: Physical and technological surveillance combining experienced analysts with expert field investigators — for a complete and verified picture. Use of advanced evidence-gathering tools, in full compliance with all Israeli legal requirements.
services_p_53: Identifying defamation, cyberbullying, and exposing anonymous online identities. Mapping digital presence, uncovering suspicious online activity, and collecting digital evidence.
services_p_55: Mapping and locating hidden assets, bank accounts, real estate, companies, and rights in Israel and abroad. A dedicated service for attorneys, creditors, and litigants seeking to enforce court judgments.
services_p_56: Background checks, ownership verification, and dispute investigation in the real estate sector. Uncovering property history, identifying hidden stakeholders, and locating critical information prior to significant real estate transactions.
services_p_57: Collecting evidence, testimonies, and documents to support legal proceedings. Close collaboration with attorneys throughout all stages of the process — from case preparation through to conclusion.
services_p_58: Background checks on individuals and companies — in Israel and abroad. Uncovering criminal history, legal proceedings, business connections, and other relevant information before entering into a business partnership.
services_p_60: Professional tracing of individuals who have lost contact — debtors, heirs, witnesses, former partners, and more. Use of advanced OSINT methods and field operations for fast and accurate tracing.
services_p_61: Full investigative support during disputes between business partners, commercial claims, and management conflicts. Evidence collection, uncovering concealed actions, and certified documentation for use in legal proceedings.
services_p_62: A comprehensive and discreet pre-marriage background check — including criminal history, personal and family status, debts and financial standing, and overall credibility. Conducted in complete confidentiality and with speed.
services_p_63: In an era where information is the most important strategic asset, P.R.D.S Investigations provides its clients with a meaningful competitive advantage. We perform business intelligence collection, analysis, and processing at a high professional level — both in Israel and abroad — while maintaining absolute discretion and full compliance with all legal requirements.
services_p_64: Our business intelligence service is designed for senior executives, investors, attorneys, and corporations requiring a reliable situational picture before making critical decisions. Our team, which includes analysts with backgrounds in the defense establishment, brings a proven intelligence methodology to the business world.
services_p_65: Comprehensive mapping of business activity, ownership structure, financial status, corporate history, and the interrelationships between business entities — in Israel and in many countries worldwide.
services_p_66: Analysis of competitors, potential partners, and market players — for investment decision-making, entering a new market, or risk assessment in strategic transactions.
services_p_67: Comprehensive Due Diligence prior to partnerships, mergers, acquisitions, and investments — including financial, legal, and reputational background checks on the counterparty.
services_p_68: Reputation assessment, identification of business and personal connections, exposure of conflicts of interest and reputational risks — before entering into any significant business partnership.
services_p_69: Targeted intelligence gathering to support complex decisions — including identification of assets, hidden stakeholders, pending legal claims, and more.
services_p_70: Our team applies proven intelligence approaches developed in the field — OSINT, HUMINT, and commercial sources — to gather a complete and reliable situational picture.
services_p_71: Every business intelligence investigation is conducted in absolute confidentiality. Reports are delivered directly to the client only, with no external copies retained.
services_p_72: פרד"ס חקירות offers private investigation and business intelligence services to both private and corporate clients — in Israel and abroad. Every service is tailored to the specific need and carried out with complete discretion.
services_p_73: Assessment of financial capacity and stability, exposure of fraud and embezzlement, analysis of suspicious cash flows, and tracing hidden assets. We provide a complete and reliable financial picture for informed decision-making.
services_p_74: In-depth examination prior to business partnerships, investments, mergers, and acquisitions. We investigate the financial, legal, and reputational background of all parties, and deliver clear, detailed reports for confident decision-making.
services_p_75: Identifying organizational vulnerabilities before they become liabilities. We review internal and external exposures, assess partner and supplier risks, and provide actionable recommendations to strengthen business defenses.
services_p_76: Uncovering theft, embezzlement, information leaks, and industrial espionage within the organization. Our investigations are conducted in absolute confidentiality, while maintaining business continuity and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
services_p_77: Physical and technological surveillance combining experienced analysts from the security establishment with expert field investigators — for a complete and verified picture. Certified and reliable documentation for use in legal and business proceedings.
services_p_78: Identifying sources of defamation, cyberbullying, and exposing anonymous identities on social networks and forums. We employ advanced methods to collect digital evidence admissible in court.
services_p_79: Locating hidden assets, bank accounts, real estate, vehicles, and businesses of debtors in Israel and abroad. Our service assists creditors, attorneys, and companies in enforcing their rights and collecting debts.
services_p_80: Comprehensive background checks on properties, ownership, liens, disputes, and suspicious transactions. We investigate ownership history, identify related parties, and verify information prior to significant real estate transactions.
services_p_81: In-depth background checks on business people, senior executives, and companies — in Israel and abroad. We examine criminal history, reputation, business connections, and regulatory compliance before recruitment, partnership, or investment.
services_p_82: Professional location of individuals who have lost contact — debtors, heirs, witnesses, former partners, and more. Using advanced OSINT methods and fieldwork for fast, accurate, and discreet results.
services_p_83: Full investigative support during disputes between business partners, commercial claims, and management conflicts. Evidence gathering, exposure of covert actions, and certified documentation for use in legal proceedings.
services_p_84: Comprehensive and discreet pre-marital background check — including criminal history, personal and family status, debts and financial standing, and overall credibility. Conducted in complete confidentiality and with speed.
services_p_85: פרד"ס חקירות provides full professional support to attorneys and law firms: collection of admissible evidence, witness investigation, verification of disputed facts, and detailed documentation for court files. All our actions are carried out in accordance with Israeli law requirements and meet the highest standards of evidentiary admissibility.
services_p_86: Through an international network of contacts and collaborations with professional intelligence sources worldwide, we conduct due diligence, financial investigations, and comprehensive background checks on individuals and businesses outside Israel — in Europe, North America, and emerging markets. All information is collected lawfully and presented in a structured, professional report.
services_p_87: פרד"ס חקירות operates in full compliance with all licensing, legal, and professional ethics requirements — and is committed to the highest standards in the field of private investigation and business intelligence.
services_p_88: The firm is managed by Yair Bloom, a licensed private investigator on behalf of the Ministry of Justice, operating in accordance with the Private Investigators and Security Services Law. All of our private business investigation activities are conducted within the full license framework, in complete compliance with Israeli regulatory requirements. We bear full professional responsibility for every stage of the investigation process — from the initial mandate through to the submission of findings.
services_p_89: All information entrusted to us — whether in the context of due diligence, internal organizational investigations, or financial inquiries — is handled with complete and absolute confidentiality. We are committed to Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA) with every client, and strictly adhere to rigorous data security protocols throughout all stages of our work. Discretion is not merely a value — it is an operational standard in every project.
services_p_90: פרד"ס חקירות specializes in the business, financial, legal, and personal domains. Our services include business intelligence, financial investigations, background checks on business people, locating individuals and assets, investigations during business disputes, surveillance combining analysts and fieldwork, exposure of industrial espionage, and pre-marital partner checks — all conducted within the bounds of the law and by lawful means only. We ensure that every investigative action complies with the requirements of Israeli law.

case_examples_h3_7: Cases from the Field: The Analysis, the Evidence, and the Bottom Line.
case_examples_p_28: A leading beverage company faced the consistent disappearance of alcohol inventory on a large scale, with no witnesses or clear leads. The firm was asked to conduct a comprehensive investigation to identify the source of the failure, provide an accurate picture of the situation, and restore professional peace of mind to the organization.
case_examples_p_29: A leading beverage company discovered that a significant quantity of alcohol products had vanished from production cycles without any clear explanation. Beyond the severe financial exposure, the uncertainty created a heavy burden and a creeping suspicion toward the staff and management, threatening to gravely damage the fabric of relationships and the organizational culture built over many years.
case_examples_p_30: To conclusively and independently identify the source of the inventory loss, determine whether it stemmed from human involvement or a systemic failure, and provide management with decisive, evidence-based findings that would enable informed decisions with complete peace of mind and certainty.
case_examples_p_31: We conducted a systematic reconstruction of events and an end-to-end review of all production stages. The process included operational data analysis across multiple production cycles, combined with meticulous physical and technological inspections of the work environment.
case_examples_p_32: The investigation completely ruled out any human or criminal involvement on the part of the employees. The technical examination identified two defective filling heads in the bottling machine that caused a concealed and consistent leak during routine work breaks. Due to the structure of the production floor, the leaked liquid was absorbed and drained directly without leaving any visible traces, resulting in a significant numerical discrepancy that accumulated over several months.
case_examples_p_33: Upon presentation of the evidence-based findings, the source of the financial loss was identified and addressed immediately. The most significant outcome for the owner was the removal of the oppressive suspicion from the organization's staff and the full restoration of trust and professional peace of mind within the company — a testament to the firm's guiding principle: not every investigation ends in guilt, and sometimes the greatest achievement is unequivocally proving people's innocence.
case_examples_p_34: "The relief was immediate. The investigation report not only stopped the financial bleeding, but above all lifted a heavy cloud of suspicion and fully restored my trust in my team."
case_examples_p_35: — Client's conclusion upon receiving the report
case_examples_p_37: A large company operating an e-commerce and consumer club discovered that a mobile device had gone missing from its central warehouse. What initially appeared to be an isolated incident quickly revealed suspicions of a systematic and ongoing scheme. We were engaged to conduct a comprehensive and focused investigation to identify those responsible and uncover the method of operation.
case_examples_p_38: The disappearance of a single mobile device from the central warehouse of an e-commerce company raised suspicions that this was not a random incident, but rather a systematic scheme that had been concealed for many months. The primary challenge was the complete absence of official inventory records for the missing merchandise, which prevented the possibility of tracing the source of the failure through conventional means.
case_examples_p_39: To narrow suspicion from a list of eight employees with warehouse access, conduct a comprehensive in-depth investigation, and compile decisive and unambiguous evidence proving who was behind the inventory disappearance and the method they used.
case_examples_p_40: The firm's team conducted extensive intelligence and technological research (OSINT) on all suspects, cross-referencing data and digital activity. These indicators allowed the focus to be narrowed to just two key employees. Subsequently, strategic and structured interviews were conducted with all those involved, supported by professional polygraph examinations to corroborate the findings.
case_examples_p_41: The investigation revealed that the logistics team leader — who held full authority and a sensitive position of trust over the entry and exit of goods — exploited his role to systematically intercept new devices immediately upon arrival, before they were recorded in the company's inventory systems. The devices were sold privately without leaving any paper trail, while completely suppressing receiving documentation.
case_examples_p_42: Through the combination of advanced digital intelligence and targeted frontal interviews, the systematic embezzlement was fully exposed and completely halted. A decisive findings report was submitted to company management, enabling full legal and disciplinary action, along with recommendations for remedying the security vulnerabilities in the logistics system.
case_examples_p_43: "Knowing that the person responsible for preventing losses was the one running the embezzlement was difficult, but the precise report we received provided us with conclusive evidence, peace of mind, and the ability to take immediate legal action."

case_examples_p_46: A real estate and development company encountered persistent obstacles and an inability to win and execute projects in a specific locality, following opposition from an influential municipal figure. The firm was engaged to conduct a comprehensive investigation to understand the motives behind these obstacles and examine whether foreign considerations or hidden interests were driving the decision-making.
case_examples_p_47: A leading real estate company found itself repeatedly excluded from business opportunities and project execution in a particular locality, due to what appeared to be consistent and deliberate opposition from a local elected official. The company needed to uncover the true reason behind these obstacles, to determine whether it was facing fair competition or unlawful activity preventing it from operating in the field.
case_examples_p_48: To map the full scope of the subject's connections, affiliations, and business activity, with the aim of identifying hidden personal or commercial interests that could explain his opposition to the real estate company and his blocking of its projects in the area.
case_examples_p_49: The firm's team conducted an in-depth intelligence investigation based on open sources (OSINT) and a scan of commercial and financial databases. The investigation included cross-referencing business registrations, analysis of digital connections, official committee protocols and media presence, alongside a meticulous examination of the entities and companies operating and executing public projects in the same geographic area.
case_examples_p_50: The investigation revealed that the elected official was acting unlawfully and in serious conflict of interest: alongside his public role influencing the approval of projects and infrastructure, he was effectively serving as a developer in the employ of a company in direct competition with the real estate firm (the client). It further emerged that his ties with the competing company were deep and included direct involvement in projects in the area, while no public conflict of interest declaration — as required by law — was found regarding this activity.
case_examples_p_51: The firm's report provided the real estate company with the "smoking gun" — conclusive, evidence-based proof that the professional obstacles it faced stemmed from a foreign business interest and unlawful activity by the subject of the investigation on behalf of the competing company. This strategic intelligence gave the company a decisive legal and business advantage in the dispute, and opened the path for it to act through the relevant administrative and legal channels to remove the obstacles and protect its rights.
case_examples_p_52: "Thanks to the firm's report, we understood that we hadn't lost in fair competition, but had been blocked by a party acting in serious conflict of interest on behalf of our competitors. The evidence we received completely shifted the balance of power in the dispute."
